economics.text: Marginal cost of a reused launch about $15 million; refurbishing a booster about $250,000.

economics.text: Block 5 was designed to fly ten times with minor maintenance, and potentially up to 100 times with refurbishment.

history.text: The Delta Clipper Experimental (DC-X) makes its first vertical take-off and landing, a sub-scale test of a reusable rocket.
The Grasshopper test vehicle hops up to 744 m and lands on its legs.
Blue Origin's New Shepard lands vertically after a suborbital flight to space.
First landing of an orbital-class booster: Falcon 9 Flight 20 (Orbcomm OG2) returns to Landing Zone 1, Cape Canaveral, at 8:29 pm local time (01:29 UTC on 22 December).
First landing on a drone ship at sea (CRS-8 mission).
First re-flight of a landed orbital booster (SES-10).
